title: ClinicalBench：面向临床QA的断言感知检索压力测试
summary: 提出ClinicalBench基准和EpiKG方法，用于评估临床QA中基于真实电子病历的检索步骤。EpiKG通过断言标签和时间标签构建患者知识图谱，按问题意图路由检索。在43名MIMIC-IV患者、400个问题上测试，相比基线提升8.84个百分点。发现56%的自动生成参考答案有缺陷，强调需要医生裁决。
summary_en: Proposes ClinicalBench benchmark and EpiKG method to evaluate retrieval over real EHR notes for clinical QA. EpiKG uses assertion and temporality labels in a patient KG, routing retrieval by question intent. Achieves +8.84 pp over baseline on 400 questions from 43 MIMIC-IV patients. Finds 56% of auto-generated reference answers defective, highlighting need for physician adjudication.
